Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with platforms like Stripe and PayPal is that they prioritize their own interests over those of their users. They may freeze your account, charge excessive fees, or even shut you down without warning. But COREMERCH's infrastructure is different. By using blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare's secure infrastructure, you can build a payment and delivery pipeline that is entirely under your control. This means that you can avoid the risks and limitations associated with traditional payment platforms and focus on growing your business without worrying about your payments being held hostage.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need a few key tools and resources. First, you'll need a digital product or service to sell, such as an ebook, course, or software. Next, you'll need a domain name and web hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. You'll also need a payment processor like NOWPayments, which offers 300+ cryptocurrencies and a 0.5% fee. Finally, you'll need to choose a backend logic solution, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to manage your orders and deliveries.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate your payment processor with your backend logic solution. This will allow you to automatically verify payments on-chain and deliver your products to your customers. You can use NOWPayments' API to connect with your backend logic solution and set up a webhook that fires the moment a payment is confirmed on-chain. From there, you can use Cloudflare's Workers or Google Apps Script to manage your orders and deliveries and ensure that your products are delivered to your customers quickly and securely.
You own everything after deployment, including your payment and delivery pipeline.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. To do this, simply load your digital product into your infrastructure and send a test transaction to yourself. This will help you verify that your pipeline is working correctly and that your customers can successfully complete a purchase. From there, you can start promoting your product to your customers and watching your sales grow as you build a truly sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your infrastructure is easy with COREMERCH's solutions. Simply load more products into your pipeline, set up additional payment processors, and configure your backend logic solution to handle increased traffic. You can also use Cloudflare's Workers or Google Apps Script to automate tasks and optimize your infrastructure for performance and security. With COREMERCH's solutions, you can scale your business quickly and easily without worrying about the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
